basic_info.description:
Ideally located near the highly coveted Westwood Park, Riordan High School, City College of San Francisco, Whole Foods, and the vibrant Ocean Avenue corridor with its eclectic mix of shops, cafes, and restaurants, this property offers unparalleled convenience.

Discover a rare opportunity to own a delightful two-story residence with potential for expansion downstairs, nestled in the heart of San Francisco. Built in 1923, this charming 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom home spans 1,047 square feet, blending vintage character with modern convenience. The spacious bedrooms are filled with natural light, complemented by a well-appointed bathroom. A convenient one-car garage offers additional storage space.

The generous 2,879 sq. ft. lot provides ample outdoor space for gardening, entertaining, or future expansion.
Whether you're a first-time homebuyer, investor, or looking to downsize, this home is a rare gem in San Francisco's dynamic real estate market. Schedule a viewing today and envision the possibilities!
